summary: One message. That is the entire week on this account. Between Aug 21 and Aug 28 the only thing anyone typed into Mila x ALTR was Mayson posting the bare string 'crystalmila.vip' into the OnlyFans topic at 02:53 on Aug 23 — no greeting, no explanation of what the link is, no ask, no follow-up. Callie did not reply, and she has not written since 'Sent:)' on Aug 17: eleven days of client silence, her longest stretch since onboarding. Stephski and Michelle both went quiet the same night (Aug 17); Mica's reel-inspo cadence has now missed two consecutive weeks (last drop Aug 13, 15 days ago); Derrek has not posted since Aug 1 (27 days); Vivek, introduced Jul 29 as the Meta Support escalation route, has now been in the chat 30 days without ever sending a message. Nothing was resolved, nothing was chased, and every open item simply aged another seven days. The two that matter most: Callie's Aug 17 wire — sent to an account number Stephski changed mid-relationship on the Aug 15 invoice, after telling her on Jul 13 to 'just repeat to the same account' — has now gone 11 days with no receipt confirmation and no statement of which account it landed in; and her Aug 8 question asking ALTR to 'double check it doesn't come through twice' is 20 days unanswered after Stephski promised 'Will update you shortly!' on Aug 11. Meanwhile 48 videos she uploaded on Aug 17 are sitting in a Drive feeding a posting programme that has been paused since roughly late July, and the only response she has ever had to them is 'yayyy perfect babes tyyy 🫶🏼'. This is not a quiet week. It is an account where the client has stopped asking for things, ALTR has stopped answering, and the next invoice (Aug 15-31, due on cadence around Sep 1) is about to land on top of an unreconciled payment.

health.rationale: Down 12 from 66 (and from 74 and 82 in the two weeks before that — a 28-point slide in four weeks). The delta is not driven by anything the client did; she did nothing, because she has stopped engaging. It is driven by ALTR producing exactly one message in seven days, and that message being a context-free 15-character domain posted at 2:53am by Mayson, who had not spoken in the chat since Jul 10. Every single open item aged seven days with zero action: the unverified Aug 17 wire is now 11 days unconfirmed against a changed account number; the duplicate-payment question is 20 days unanswered; Derrek's 'plenty of updates starting next week' promise from Aug 1 is 27 days overdue and he has not written since making it; Vivek has been Meta Support for 30 days and has never spoken; Michelle's Jul 8 promise to send post links is 51 days old; and Mica's reel-inspo drop — for two months the only reliable proactive touch on this account — has now been missed twice running. The score is not lower only because there is no active complaint, no dispute, and no payment default: the client has always paid. But three straight weeks of falling engagement followed by total mutual silence, with money unreconciled and a full content bank unused, is the shape of a churn, not a lull.
